result.description:
On behalf of our client, we are seeking a full-time experienced IT Network Support Administrator to manage and support our clients' network environment and day-to-day IT infrastructure. This role will play a key part in keeping systems running smoothly, resolving technical issues, and supporting the ongoing stability and security of the business’ network operations.
Key Responsibilities:

In this role, you will:
• Maintain and support the organisation’s network environment, including servers, routers, switches and associated systems
• Monitor system performance and respond to network or connectivity issues in a timely manner
• Troubleshoot faults and outages, identifying root causes and implementing practical solutions
• Manage user access, permissions and system configurations in line with internal policies
• Assist with system updates, upgrades and routine maintenance to ensure network security and reliability
• Keep accurate records of network configurations, assets and changes
• Work with external IT providers or vendors where required to support system improvements or issue resolution
• Provide support to internal users on network-related issues and assist with general IT queries

Qualifications, Skills & Experience
• A Bachelor’s degree or higher qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related discipline; or
• At least 5 years' practical experience and/or relevant industry certifications demonstrating capability in network administration and support
• Proven experience in network administration, IT support, or a similar infrastructure-focused role
• Strong understanding of network environments, including configuration, maintenance and troubleshooting
• Experience supporting users and resolving system or connectivity issues
• Sound understanding of system security, access control and data protection practices
• Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate documentation
• Good organisational skills and the ability to manage competing tasks
• Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical users

Desirable
• Relevant certifications (e.g. Cisco, CompTIA, Microsoft or similar)
• Exposure to cloud-based or hybrid environments
• Experience working in a small-to-medium business IT environment or with external IT providers
 
Salary: $90,000 - $110,000 per annum (excluding superannuation)

result.description: SPARTAN EQUIPMENTS AUSTRALIA PTY LTD   Key Responsibilities    Prepare detailed 2D fabrication drawings, 3D CAD models, layouts and engineering designs for transport equipment, trailers and related mechanical assemblies under the guidance of Mechanical Engineers, ensuring compliance with project specifications and manufacturing requirements.  Assist Mechanical Engineers and Engineering Technologists in the design, development and refinement of mechanical equipment, components and production systems by interpreting technical specifications, client requirements and engineering concepts.   Select appropriate drafting methods, CAD tools, design software and engineering resources to support efficient design development, manufacturing processes and project delivery.   Support the assembly and installation of new and modified mechanical assemblies, components and equipment by preparing accurate fabrication drawings, workshop documentation and technical instructions for production teams.   Estimate material quantities, prepare Bills of Materials (BOMs), determine component requirements and assist in assessing manufacturing resources and production needs for engineering projects.   Assist with engineering testing activities by reviewing design performance, evaluating manufacturing outcomes and supporting investigations to ensure equipment and components meet operational requirements.   Collect, analyse and interpret engineering data, perform technical calculations and prepare diagrams, drawings and documentation to support design development, manufacturing processes and project planning.   Coordinate and support inspection, quality assurance and maintenance activities by maintaining drawing registers, revision records and technical documentation to ensure the accuracy and traceability of engineering information.   Ensure all designs, drawings, fabrication documentation and completed work comply with applicable Australian Standards, engineering specifications, quality requirements, safety regulations and contractual obligations, while implementing modifications and continuous improvements where required.       Qualifications & Experience    Diploma or higher qualification in Engineering Drafting, Engineering Design, Mechanical Drafting, or a related field.   Minimum 1-3 years of relevant mechanical drafting experience.   Proficiency in CAD software such as SolidWorks, AutoCAD, and Inventor.   Strong knowledge of fabrication processes, manufacturing methods, materials, and tolerances.   Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and specifications accurately.   Excellent attention to detail, communication, and teamwork skills.      About Company     SPARTAN EQUIPMENTS
